lines.text: Paul says the church's gatherings do more harm than good, because each one eats without sharing while another gets drunk.
Paul says he received from Peter that on the night Jesus was betrayed, He took bread, gave thanks and broke it.
After supper Jesus took the cup, calling it the law given at Sinai, and said to do this in remembrance of Him.

wrong_details.true: the new covenant in My blood

lines.text: Each one must examine himself before eating, because eating and drinking without recognizing the body brings judgment on himself.
Paul tells them to wait for one another when they come together to eat, and anyone hungry should eat at home.
